subject.title: [Bug]: z.ai endpoint auto-detection probe sends no User-Agent → z.ai 429s it, detectZaiEndpoint returns null, Coding Plan onboarding fails

question: Which linked Z.AI User-Agent fix PR should be treated as the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: There are multiple open PRs with the same closing target and slightly different proof/test coverage, so automation should not open another repair or close the issue before a maintainer selects and lands one.

options.title: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98123
options.body: This candidate has the most focused stated scope and broader local validation in its body, so it is the best current canonical path if the branch is refreshed and proof is acceptable.

options.title: Promote another existing PR
options.body: A maintainer can instead choose one of the other open same-scope PRs if its head, proof, or contributor follow-up is better at review time.

options.title: Close duplicate PRs after merge
options.body: After one fix lands, the remaining same-scope PRs can be closed as superseded with a link to the merged implementation.

recommendation.title: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98123
recommendation.body: This candidate has the most focused stated scope and broader local validation in its body, so it is the best current canonical path if the branch is refreshed and proof is acceptable.
